scope: Follow-up revisions of generated p5.js layers in Studio and Explorations; persistent, browsable saved layer snapshots reusable through gallery and Studio picker.
supersedes_scope: The one-shot-only Explorations and no-transfer limits of evidence/web/prompt-web-integration-review.json. Its historical evidence and other limits remain intact.
artist_task: Refine existing artwork by describing a change, then keep a named generated layer to use in another sketch.
behavior: Follow-up context includes exact source files, declarations, licensing and current replay inputs; the coordinator fixes candidate scope to the artist request.
Studio candidate application is explicit and undoable; failed runs do not publish candidates. Saving is disabled while a candidate or control edit is pending.
Explorations revises the selected generated layer or explicitly generates a fresh composition; failed follow-ups preserve the last successful result.
Saved layers validate source bytes, declared controls and preview render identity without running source. Snapshots are atomic JSON records alongside immutable artifacts.
Each reuse gets a fresh id and detached controls; destination background and other layers stay intact, with the existing eight-layer limit.
Gallery has a Saved layers category with image/source detail pages. Studio picker can insert saved layers directly.
Sticky Studio canvas no longer overlaps the prompt panel.
